import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter to expression/copy_number features
    expr_ids = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if t in ('expression', 'copy_number')]
    expr_cols = [feats.column(fid) for fid in expr_ids]
    
    # Compute correlation matrix
    X = feats.x[:, expr_cols]
    corr = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    
    # Find highly correlated pairs (|r| >= 0.6)
    high_corr_pairs = []
    for i in range(len(expr_ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(expr_ids)):
            if abs(corr[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                high_corr_pairs.append((expr_ids[i], expr_ids[j]))
    
    # Cluster features based on correlations
    if len(high_corr_pairs) > 0:
        # Build adjacency matrix
        n_features = len(expr_ids)
        adj = np.zeros((n_features, n_features))
        for a, b in high_corr_pairs:
            ia, ib = expr_ids.index(a), expr_ids.index(b)
            adj[ia, ib] = adj[ib, ia] = 1
        
        # Hierarchical clustering
        clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=1, linkage='complete')
        clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1 - adj)
        
        # Select cluster with highest mean effect size
        best_cluster = max(set(clusters), key=lambda c: np.mean([abs(np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)] - 
                                                                          feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])) 
                                                                for fid in expr_ids if clusters[expr_ids.index(fid)] == c]))
        
        module_features = [fid for fid in expr_ids if clusters[expr_ids.index(fid)] == best_cluster]
        
        # Compute weighted score using first principal component
        module_data = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in module_features]]
        _, _, vt = np.linalg.svd(module_data, full_matrices=False)
        weights = vt[0] / np.linalg.norm(vt[0])
        loadings = dict(zip(module_features, weights))
        
        return Design(
            drivers=tuple(module_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]),
            columns=tuple(module_features),
            products=(),
            loadings=loadings
        )
    
    # No strong module found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
